## Required human review

- Review each user journey with intended users; the persona descriptions are hypotheses, not completed interviews.
- Review each model and control level, including non-gate and measurement-based workflows.
- Review every conditional edge before cohort registration; SDK omissions cannot create new exceptions.
- Exercise each function variant, boundary case and negative case; one linked task is not evidence that all variants are covered.
- Audit full user outcomes, frontend/component attribution and externally supplied functionality.
- Review inaccessible hardware, proprietary components, unusual platforms and large-instance oracle limitations as evidence gaps.
- Record any new need in the catalog, or give an explicit scope/relevance rationale; absence from current SDKs is not an exclusion reason.
- Record review decisions and unresolved objections before freezing executable instances.
